title.value: Active Keyword Selection to Track Evolving Topics on Twitter
title.justification: This is the exact title of the paper as stated in the provided document.
title.quote: Active Keyword Selection to Track Evolving Topics on Twitter

extractions.description: The paper introduces an active learning method, K EY S ELECT, designed to refine query keywords used for collecting high-quality, topic-relevant data from Twitter. This method is illustrated using a COVID-19 Twitter dataset, focusing on sub-topics like Vaccine, Mask, and Lockdown. The paper emphasizes the challenges of selecting optimal keywords for data collection and offers a solution to improve the relevance and volume of topic-related tweets collected.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily focuses on the development of a method for improving data collection on Twitter through keyword selection. While the dataset used for illustration is related to COVID-19, the central theme is methodological advancement rather than sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: How can we study social interactions on evolving topics at a mass scale? Over the past decade, researchers from diverse fields such as economics, political science, and public health have often done this by querying Twitter’s public API endpoints with hand-picked topical keywords to search or stream discussions.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not directly address any Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development themes. While it uses a COVID-19 dataset for illustration, the focus is on computational methods rather than environmental or sustainability themes.
primary_category.quote: In this paper, we propose an active learning method for rapidly refining query keywords to increase both the yielded topic relevance and dataset size.

applications.value: Improving data collection from Twitter through active keyword selection to enhance topic relevance and dataset size.
applications.justification: The paper details a method that increases the efficiency of data collection by refining keywords, thus improving the relevance and volume of collected data.
applications.quote: We propose an active learning method for rapidly refining query keywords to increase both the yielded topic relevance and dataset size.

applications.value: Tracking COVID-19 related discussions on Twitter by refining and selecting keywords relevant to sub-topics such as Vaccine, Mask, and Lockdown.
applications.justification: The method introduced was illustrated using a COVID-19 Twitter dataset, focusing on tracking discussions of specific pandemic-related sub-topics.
applications.quote: leveraging 21 million tweets over the month of April 2020 from [4] by putting a focus on the three sub-topics of Vaccine, Mask, and Lockdown.

new_primary_category.quote: We demonstrate that K EY S ELECT can yield up to a 25% increase in retrieved volume of users and tweets on a given topic, with an average recall value 2.8 times greater than its baselines.
